SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"./interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @title UsdtYieldVault\n/// @notice Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3 and tracks\n///         depositor ownership with internal shares.\n/// @dev Shares carry 18 decimals while USDT carries 6, so the first depositor\n///      mints at `SHARE_SCALE`. Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\ncontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n\n    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n\n    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n\n    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n\n    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n\n    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n\n    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n\n    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n    uint256 public totalShares;\n\n    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n\n    /// @notice Shares held per depositor.\n    mapping(address account => uint256 shares) public shareBalance;\n\n    event Deposited(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n\n    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n    error NoSharesMinted();\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error InsufficientShares();\n\n    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n    /// @param _aUsdt The Aave aUSDT receipt token.\n    /// @param _aavePool The Aave V3 pool.\n    /// @param _depositFeeBps Initial deposit fee in basis points.\n    /// @param initialOwner Address granted ownership.\n    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n        Ownable(initialOwner)\n    {\n        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n\n        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n\n        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n\n        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n\n        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n        totalShares += shares;\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n\n        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] -= shares;\n        totalShares -= shares;\n        totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets;\n\n        aavePool.withdraw(address(usdt), netAssets, msg.sender);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, netAssets, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Updates the deposit fee.\n    /// @param newFeeBps New deposit fee in basis points.\n    function setDepositFee(uint256 newFeeBps) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 previousFeeBps = depositFeeBps;\n        depositFeeBps = newFeeBps;\n        emit DepositFeeUpdated(previousFeeBps, newFeeBps);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pauses deposits and withdrawals.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT currently tracked by the vault, in base units.\n    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return totalAssetsStored;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts a USDT amount into shares at the current share price.\n    /// @param assets USDT amount in base units.\n    /// @return Shares corresponding to `assets`.\n    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, totalAssetsStored);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts shares into a USDT amount at the current share price.\n    /// @param shares Share amount.\n    /// @return USDT in base units corresponding to `shares`.\n    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the withdrawal fee.\n    function balanceOfUnderlying(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return convertToAssets(shareBalance[account]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current share price, expressed as USDT base units per 1e18 shares.\n    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) return 1e18 / SHARE_SCALE;\n        return totalAssetsStored.mulDiv(1e18, totalShares);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":178,"startLine":1,"totalLines":178}}}

SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\ncontract UsdtYieldVaultTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    MockAavePool public pool;\n    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n\n    address public owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 public constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 public constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.usdt()), address(usdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aUsdt()), address(aUsdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAavePool() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aavePool()), address(pool));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsOwner() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), owner);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsDepositFee() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), INITIAL_FEE_BPS);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                               CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_BpsDenominator() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 10_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_ShareScale() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.SHARE_SCALE(), 1e12);\n    }\n\n    function test_MinDeposit() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                DEPOSIT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_DepositMintsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositTransfersUsdtFromDepositor() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositSuppliesToAave() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Deposited(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, 999e18, 1e6);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_SecondDepositorMintsShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_DepositBelowMinimum() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.AmountBelowMinimum.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1e6 - 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                WITHDRAW\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawReturnsUsdt() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 997e6);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawBurnsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawEmitsEvent() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Withdrawn(alice, 997e6, shares, 3e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_PartialWithdraw() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares / 2);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), shares / 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawZeroShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.ZeroShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(0);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawExceedsBalance() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.InsufficientShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares + 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  FEES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeUpdatesValue() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(false, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.DepositFeeUpdated(INITIAL_FEE_BPS, 25);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeToZero() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerSetsDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 PAUSING\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_PauseBlocksDeposit() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_UnpauseRestoresDeposit() public {\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.unpause();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerPauses() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.pause();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  VIEWS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_TotalAssetsStartsAtZero() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceStartsAtOneUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.sharePrice(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 1e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlying() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlyingIsZeroForNonDepositor() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), 0);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":300,"startLine":1,"totalLines":300}}}

SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Receipt token minted by {MockAavePool}, mirroring aUSDT.\ncontract MockAToken is ERC20 {\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _burn(from, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Stand-in for the Aave V3 pool used across the test suite.\ncontract MockAavePool is IAavePool {\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    MockAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new MockAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEWVrSAW3bB3ZosyGSx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7604,"cache_read_input_tokens":39712,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":7604},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"3ae4f937-5a2b-4d50-9106-84c92d94ed94","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:18:31.613Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEWTgDTsACBeaQEdCri"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEWVrSAW3bB3ZosyGSx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Hzp8gb8wYKVUKH6cBRaASZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/MainnetFork.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Mainnet USDT exposes `approve`/`transfer` with NO return value.\ninterface IUsdtNonStandard {\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external; // returns nothing\n    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256);\n    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);\n    function basisPointsRate() external view returns (uint256);\n    function maximumFee() external view returns (uint256);\n}\n\n/// @notice Deploys the vault as-is against the real mainnet USDT and the real Aave V3 Pool.\n/// @dev Run with:\n///        forge test --root . --match-path 'test/fork/*' -vv\n///      Override the endpoint with MAINNET_RPC_URL if the default public node is rate limited.\ncontract MainnetForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_V3_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_V3_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() is unusable against the real USDT contract\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the standard IERC20 ABI, which\n    ///         expects a 32-byte `bool` back. Mainnet USDT returns 0 bytes, so the ABI\n    ///         decoder reverts and EVERY deposit fails. The vault can never take a deposit.\n    function test_Fork_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnetUsdt() public {\n        assertEq(IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice funded\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(vault).call(abi.encodeCall(UsdtYieldVault.deposit, (1_000e6)));\n\n        console2.log(\"deposit() succeeded:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertFalse(ok, \"deposit MUST have reverted against real USDT\");\n\n        // The USDT never left alice: the whole tx rolled back.\n        assertEq(IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice keeps her USDT\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing supplied to Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Root cause, isolated: mainnet USDT's `approve` returns zero bytes of data.\n    function test_Fork_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(1), 1));\n\n        console2.log(\"raw approve ok:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"raw approve returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertTrue(ok, \"raw approve itself succeeds\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"mainnet USDT returns NO data from approve\");\n\n        // Same call, decoded as IERC20 (what the vault does) -> reverts.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(address(1), 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  real aUSDT rebases; the vault's accounting cannot see it\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Supplying to the real Aave V3 pool yields an aUSDT balance that grows with time.\n    ///         `UsdtYieldVault.totalAssets()` returns `totalAssetsStored`, a plain counter that\n    ///         only ever moves on deposit/withdraw. It never reads `aUsdt.balanceOf(this)`, so\n    ///         none of this growth is ever credited to shareholders.\n    function test_Fork_RealAUsdtBalanceGrowsButVaultCounterCannot() public {\n        address supplier = makeAddr(\"supplier\");\n        deal(USDT, supplier, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(supplier);\n        IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).approve(AAVE_V3_POOL, 1_000_000e6);\n        (bool ok,) =\n            AAVE_V3_POOL.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"supply(address,uint256,address,uint16)\", USDT, 1_000_000e6, supplier, uint16(0)));\n        require(ok, \"aave supply failed\");\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aBefore = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 aAfter = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT at t0          :\", aBefore);\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT after 365 days :\", aAfter);\n        console2.log(\"interest accrued     :\", aAfter - aBefore);\n\n        assertGt(aAfter, aBefore, \"real aUSDT accrues interest\");\n\n        // Meanwhile the vault has exactly one source of truth for user value, and it is a\n        // counter that is only ever written in deposit()/withdraw().\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"totalAssets() is just the stored counter\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  USDT's dormant transfer fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Documents the live values of USDT's owner-settable transfer fee. They are 0\n    ///         today, which is the ONLY reason the vault's `totalAssetsStored += amount`\n    ///         accounting would be correct. See the local fee-on-transfer test for what\n    ///         happens if Tether ever sets them.\n    function test_Fork_UsdtTransferFeeIsCurrentlyZero() public view {\n        uint256 rate = IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).basisPointsRate();\n        uint256 maxFee = IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).maximumFee();\n        console2.log(\"USDT basisPointsRate:\", rate);\n        console2.log(\"USDT maximumFee     :\", maxFee);\n        assertEq(rate, 0);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7604,"cache_read_input_tokens":39712,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":7604},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"3d9747ca-4678-404e-9f6c-8b9ca3078b72","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:19:02.836Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEWTgDTsACBeaQEdCri"}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Hzp8gb8wYKVUKH6cBRaASZ","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/MainnetFork.t.sol (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"1bf6d2f4-f12c-4776-bd2b-212a9cdfd297","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:19:02.856Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/MainnetFork.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Mainnet USDT exposes `approve`/`transfer` with NO return value.\ninterface IUsdtNonStandard {\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external; // returns nothing\n    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256);\n    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);\n    function basisPointsRate() external view returns (uint256);\n    function maximumFee() external view returns (uint256);\n}\n\n/// @notice Deploys the vault as-is against the real mainnet USDT and the real Aave V3 Pool.\n/// @dev Run with:\n///        forge test --root . --match-path 'test/fork/*' -vv\n///      Override the endpoint with MAINNET_RPC_URL if the default public node is rate limited.\ncontract MainnetForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_V3_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_V3_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() is unusable against the real USDT contract\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the standard IERC20 ABI, which\n    ///         expects a 32-byte `bool` back. Mainnet USDT returns 0 bytes, so the ABI\n    ///         decoder reverts and EVERY deposit fails. The vault can never take a deposit.\n    function test_Fork_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnetUsdt() public {\n        assertEq(IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice funded\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(vault).call(abi.encodeCall(UsdtYieldVault.deposit, (1_000e6)));\n\n        console2.log(\"deposit() succeeded:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertFalse(ok, \"deposit MUST have reverted against real USDT\");\n\n        // The USDT never left alice: the whole tx rolled back.\n        assertEq(IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice keeps her USDT\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing supplied to Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Root cause, isolated: mainnet USDT's `approve` returns zero bytes of data.\n    function test_Fork_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(1), 1));\n\n        console2.log(\"raw approve ok:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"raw approve returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertTrue(ok, \"raw approve itself succeeds\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"mainnet USDT returns NO data from approve\");\n\n        // Same call, decoded as IERC20 (what the vault does) -> reverts.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(address(1), 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  real aUSDT rebases; the vault's accounting cannot see it\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Supplying to the real Aave V3 pool yields an aUSDT balance that grows with time.\n    ///         `UsdtYieldVault.totalAssets()` returns `totalAssetsStored`, a plain counter that\n    ///         only ever moves on deposit/withdraw. It never reads `aUsdt.balanceOf(this)`, so\n    ///         none of this growth is ever credited to shareholders.\n    function test_Fork_RealAUsdtBalanceGrowsButVaultCounterCannot() public {\n        address supplier = makeAddr(\"supplier\");\n        deal(USDT, supplier, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(supplier);\n        IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).approve(AAVE_V3_POOL, 1_000_000e6);\n        (bool ok,) =\n            AAVE_V3_POOL.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"supply(address,uint256,address,uint16)\", USDT, 1_000_000e6, supplier, uint16(0)));\n        require(ok, \"aave supply failed\");\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aBefore = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 aAfter = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT at t0          :\", aBefore);\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT after 365 days :\", aAfter);\n        console2.log(\"interest accrued     :\", aAfter - aBefore);\n\n        assertGt(aAfter, aBefore, \"real aUSDT accrues interest\");\n\n        // Meanwhile the vault has exactly one source of truth for user value, and it is a\n        // counter that is only ever written in deposit()/withdraw().\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"totalAssets() is just the stored counter\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  USDT's dormant transfer fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Documents the live values of USDT's owner-settable transfer fee. They are 0\n    ///         today, which is the ONLY reason the vault's `totalAssetsStored += amount`\n    ///         accounting would be correct. See the local fee-on-transfer test for what\n    ///         happens if Tether ever sets them.\n    function test_Fork_UsdtTransferFeeIsCurrentlyZero() public view {\n        uint256 rate = IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).basisPointsRate();\n        uint256 maxFee = IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).maximumFee();\n        console2.log(\"USDT basisPointsRate:\", rate);\n        console2.log(\"USDT maximumFee     :\", maxFee);\n        assertEq(rate, 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

// returns nothing\n    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256);\n    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);\n    function basisPointsRate() external view returns (uint256);\n    function maximumFee() external view returns (uint256);\n}\n\n/// @notice Deploys the vault as-is against the real mainnet USDT and the real Aave V3 Pool.\n/// @dev Run with:\n///        forge test --root . --match-path 'test/fork/*' -vv\n///      Override the endpoint with MAINNET_RPC_URL if the default public node is rate limited.\ncontract MainnetForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_V3_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_V3_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() is unusable against the real USDT contract\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the standard IERC20 ABI, which\n    ///         expects a 32-byte `bool` back. Mainnet USDT returns 0 bytes, so the ABI\n    ///         decoder reverts and EVERY deposit fails. The vault can never take a deposit.\n    function test_Fork_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnetUsdt() public {\n        assertEq(IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice funded\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(vault).call(abi.encodeCall(UsdtYieldVault.deposit, (1_000e6)));\n\n        console2.log(\"deposit() succeeded:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertFalse(ok, \"deposit MUST have reverted against real USDT\");\n\n        // The USDT never left alice: the whole tx rolled back.\n        assertEq(IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice keeps her USDT\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing supplied to Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Root cause, isolated: mainnet USDT's `approve` returns zero bytes of data.\n    function test_Fork_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(1), 1));\n\n        console2.log(\"raw approve ok:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"raw approve returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertTrue(ok, \"raw approve itself succeeds\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"mainnet USDT returns NO data from approve\");\n\n        // Same call, decoded as IERC20 (what the vault does) -> reverts.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(address(1), 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  real aUSDT rebases; the vault's accounting cannot see it\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Supplying to the real Aave V3 pool yields an aUSDT balance that grows with time.\n    ///         `UsdtYieldVault.totalAssets()` returns `totalAssetsStored`, a plain counter that\n    ///         only ever moves on deposit/withdraw. It never reads `aUsdt.balanceOf(this)`, so\n    ///         none of this growth is ever credited to shareholders.\n    function test_Fork_RealAUsdtBalanceGrowsButVaultCounterCannot() public {\n        address supplier = makeAddr(\"supplier\");\n        deal(USDT, supplier, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(supplier);\n        IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).approve(AAVE_V3_POOL, 1_000_000e6);\n        (bool ok,) =\n            AAVE_V3_POOL.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"supply(address,uint256,address,uint16)\", USDT, 1_000_000e6, supplier, uint16(0)));\n        require(ok, \"aave supply failed\");\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aBefore = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 aAfter = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT at t0          :\", aBefore);\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT after 365 days :\", aAfter);\n        console2.log(\"interest accrued     :\", aAfter - aBefore);\n\n        assertGt(aAfter, aBefore, \"real aUSDT accrues interest\");\n\n        // Meanwhile the vault has exactly one source of truth for user value, and it is a\n        // counter that is only ever written in deposit()/withdraw().\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"totalAssets() is just the stored counter\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  USDT's dormant transfer fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Documents the live values of USDT's owner-settable transfer fee. They are 0\n    ///         today, which is the ONLY reason the vault's `totalAssetsStored += amount`\n    ///         accounting would be correct. See the local fee-on-transfer test for what\n    ///         happens if Tether ever sets them.\n    function test_Fork_UsdtTransferFeeIsCurrentlyZero() public view {\n        uint256 rate = IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).basisPointsRate();\n        uint256 maxFee = IUsdtNonStandard(USDT).maximumFee();\n        console2.log(\"USDT basisPointsRate:\", rate);\n        console2.log(\"USDT maximumFee     :\", maxFee);\n        assertEq(rate, 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":31,"oldLines":7,"newStart":31,"newLines":7,"lines":["     address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");"," ","     function setUp() public {","-        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com\")), FORK_BLOCK);","+        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);"," ","         vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_V3_POOL, 10, owner);"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEb8E4WkRhLGu4xkKSn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Azjb7kWNaA9meiWKgwhGjr","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/harness/Harness.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    REBASING AAVE POOL / aTOKEN\n\n    test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol mints aUSDT 1:1 and never accrues\n    interest, so the existing suite can never observe what the\n    vault does with yield. These are drop-in equivalents that DO\n    accrue, mirroring Aave V3's liquidityIndex model.\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice aToken whose balance grows with a liquidity index, like real aUSDT.\ncontract RebasingAToken is ERC20 {\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    address public immutable pool;\n    uint256 public liquidityIndex = RAY;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public scaledBalance;\n    uint256 public scaledTotalSupply;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyPool() {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) public view override returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledBalance[account] * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledTotalSupply * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function mintUnderlying(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY) / liquidityIndex;\n        scaledBalance[to] += scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply += scaled;\n    }\n\n    function burnUnderlying(address from, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY + liquidityIndex - 1) / liquidityIndex; // round up\n        require(scaledBalance[from] >= scaled, \"aToken: insufficient\");\n        scaledBalance[from] -= scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply -= scaled;\n    }\n\n    function bumpIndex(uint256 newIndex) external onlyPool {\n        liquidityIndex = newIndex;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in that pays interest.\ncontract RebasingAavePool is IAavePool {\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    RebasingAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new RebasingAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        _pull(msg.sender, amount);\n        aToken.mintUnderlying(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burnUnderlying(msg.sender, amount);\n        _push(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Accrue `bps` of interest to every aToken holder, and back it with real underlying.\n    function accrue(uint256 bps) external {\n        uint256 before = aToken.totalSupply();\n        aToken.bumpIndex((aToken.liquidityIndex() * (10_000 + bps)) / 10_000);\n        uint256 owed = aToken.totalSupply() - before;\n        MintableUsdtLike(address(underlying)).mint(address(this), owed);\n    }\n\n    function _pull(address from, uint256 amount) internal {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(underlying).call(\n            abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transferFrom(address,address,uint256)\", from, address(this), amount)\n        );\n        require(ok && (ret.length == 0 || abi.decode(ret, (bool))), \"pull failed\");\n    }\n\n    function _push(address to, uint256 amount) internal {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(underlying).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transfer(address,uint256)\", to, amount));\n        require(ok && (ret.length == 0 || abi.decode(ret, (bool))), \"push failed\");\n    }\n}\n\ninterface MintableUsdtLike {\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external;\n}\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                         USDT-LIKE TOKEN\n\n    test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol is a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20, which\n    returns `bool` from approve/transfer. Mainnet USDT does not.\n    This reproduces the real token's ABI and quirks locally, so\n    the finding is checkable without an RPC.\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice Byte-compatible stand-in for mainnet USDT (0xdAC1...1ec7).\n/// @dev Differences from a standard ERC20, all present in the real token:\n///      1. `transfer`, `transferFrom` and `approve` return NOTHING.\n///      2. `approve` reverts if the current allowance and the new value are both non-zero.\n///      3. `transfer`/`transferFrom` take an owner-settable fee (`basisPointsRate`, capped\n///         by `maximumFee`) out of the transferred amount.\ncontract UsdtLikeToken {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;\n\n    /// @notice Transfer fee in basis points. 0 on mainnet today; owner-settable.\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate;\n    /// @notice Absolute cap on the transfer fee, in base units.\n    uint256 public maximumFee;\n    address public owner;\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    constructor() {\n        owner = msg.sender;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Mirrors Tether's `setParams`.\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        require(msg.sender == owner, \"only owner\");\n        require(newBasisPoints < 20, \"bps too high\");\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * (10 ** decimals);\n    }\n\n    // NOTE: no `returns (bool)` — this is the whole point.\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            require(allowed >= value, \"USDT: allowance\");\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        // Tether's non-zero-to-non-zero guard.\n        require(!((value != 0) && (allowance[msg.sender][spender] != 0)), \"USDT: unsafe approve\");\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"USDT: balance\");\n        uint256 fee = (value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 net = value - fee;\n\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += net;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balanceOf[owner] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(from, owner, fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(from, to, net);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":633,"cache_read_input_tokens":52519,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":633},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"2ea8e20a-6d56-4af0-83c9-7137267011f8","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:20:10.452Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEb6vvitgaYsHof4n39"}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Azjb7kWNaA9meiWKgwhGjr","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/harness/Harness.sol (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"a4893db3-e542-43f8-b161-e73e66d06869","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:20:10.485Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/harness/Harness.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    REBASING AAVE POOL / aTOKEN\n\n    test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol mints aUSDT 1:1 and never accrues\n    interest, so the existing suite can never observe what the\n    vault does with yield. These are drop-in equivalents that DO\n    accrue, mirroring Aave V3's liquidityIndex model.\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice aToken whose balance grows with a liquidity index, like real aUSDT.\ncontract RebasingAToken is ERC20 {\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    address public immutable pool;\n    uint256 public liquidityIndex = RAY;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public scaledBalance;\n    uint256 public scaledTotalSupply;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyPool() {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) public view override returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledBalance[account] * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledTotalSupply * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function mintUnderlying(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY) / liquidityIndex;\n        scaledBalance[to] += scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply += scaled;\n    }\n\n    function burnUnderlying(address from, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY + liquidityIndex - 1) / liquidityIndex; // round up\n        require(scaledBalance[from] >= scaled, \"aToken: insufficient\");\n        scaledBalance[from] -= scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply -= scaled;\n    }\n\n    function bumpIndex(uint256 newIndex) external onlyPool {\n        liquidityIndex = newIndex;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in that pays interest.\ncontract RebasingAavePool is IAavePool {\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    RebasingAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new RebasingAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        _pull(msg.sender, amount);\n        aToken.mintUnderlying(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burnUnderlying(msg.sender, amount);\n        _push(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Accrue `bps` of interest to every aToken holder, and back it with real underlying.\n    function accrue(uint256 bps) external {\n        uint256 before = aToken.totalSupply();\n        aToken.bumpIndex((aToken.liquidityIndex() * (10_000 + bps)) / 10_000);\n        uint256 owed = aToken.totalSupply() - before;\n        MintableUsdtLike(address(underlying)).mint(address(this), owed);\n    }\n\n    function _pull(address from, uint256 amount) internal {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(underlying).call(\n            abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transferFrom(address,address,uint256)\", from, address(this), amount)\n        );\n        require(ok && (ret.length == 0 || abi.decode(ret, (bool))), \"pull failed\");\n    }\n\n    function _push(address to, uint256 amount) internal {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(underlying).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transfer(address,uint256)\", to, amount));\n        require(ok && (ret.length == 0 || abi.decode(ret, (bool))), \"push failed\");\n    }\n}\n\ninterface MintableUsdtLike {\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external;\n}\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                         USDT-LIKE TOKEN\n\n    test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol is a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20, which\n    returns `bool` from approve/transfer. Mainnet USDT does not.\n    This reproduces the real token's ABI and quirks locally, so\n    the finding is checkable without an RPC.\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice Byte-compatible stand-in for mainnet USDT (0xdAC1...1ec7).\n/// @dev Differences from a standard ERC20, all present in the real token:\n///      1. `transfer`, `transferFrom` and `approve` return NOTHING.\n///      2. `approve` reverts if the current allowance and the new value are both non-zero.\n///      3. `transfer`/`transferFrom` take an owner-settable fee (`basisPointsRate`, capped\n///         by `maximumFee`) out of the transferred amount.\ncontract UsdtLikeToken {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;\n\n    /// @notice Transfer fee in basis points. 0 on mainnet today; owner-settable.\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate;\n    /// @notice Absolute cap on the transfer fee, in base units.\n    uint256 public maximumFee;\n    address public owner;\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    constructor() {\n        owner = msg.sender;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Mirrors Tether's `setParams`.\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        require(msg.sender == owner, \"only owner\");\n        require(newBasisPoints < 20, \"bps too high\");\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * (10 ** decimals);\n    }\n\n    // NOTE: no `returns (bool)` — this is the whole point.\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            require(allowed >= value, \"USDT: allowance\");\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        // Tether's non-zero-to-non-zero guard.\n        require(!((value != 0) && (allowance[msg.sender][spender] != 0)), \"USDT: unsafe approve\");\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"USDT: balance\");\n        uint256 fee = (value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 net = value - fee;\n\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += net;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balanceOf[owner] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(from, owner, fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(from, to, net);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEdvaAtf8gyuby5q5av","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_011cv92NdUkV9K57ECyvExJ1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/YieldStranding.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/Harness.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The existing suite pairs the vault with a MockAavePool that mints aUSDT 1:1 and\n///         never accrues interest, so it cannot observe what happens to yield. This suite is\n///         identical except the pool pays interest, the way Aave V3 actually does.\ncontract YieldStrandingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-1  the vault earns yield and gives none of it to depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_YieldIsEarnedButNeverCreditedToDepositors() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        pool.accrue(500); // +5% interest on everything supplied\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying()  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console2.log(\"vault.sharePrice()           :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 1_050e6, \"vault really holds 1050 USDT of aUSDT\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 1_000e6, \"but totalAssets() still says 1000\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 1_000e6, \"alice is credited with 0 of the 50 USDT of yield\");\n\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"alice received back          :\", received);\n        assertEq(received, 997e6, \"alice gets principal minus the 0.3% exit fee, and zero yield\");\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n        assertLt(received, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"a full year in a 'yield vault' and she is DOWN\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After every share is burned the vault still holds real aUSDT, and every\n    ///         accounting variable that could point at it reads zero.\n    function test_StrandedValueIsUnreachableAfterFullExit() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"stranded aUSDT after full exit:\", stranded);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalShares()           :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssetsStored()     :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n\n        assertGt(stranded, 0, \"value is left behind\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n\n        // A later depositor does not inherit it either: pricing restarts from the counter.\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"bob is credited with his own deposit only\");\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(bobShares);\n\n        assertGe(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), stranded, \"alice's stranded yield is still sitting there\");\n        console2.log(\"stranded aUSDT after bob too  :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The loss is not a rounding dust artefact — it is the entire yield, and it\n    ///         compounds with time and TVL.\n    function test_StrandedValueScalesWithTimeAndTvl() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(50_000e6);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            pool.accrue(500); // five periods of 5%\n        }\n\n        uint256 realValue = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 creditedValue = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        console2.log(\"real aUSDT held    :\", realValue);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice  :\", creditedValue);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost by alice:\", realValue - creditedValue);\n\n        assertGt(realValue - creditedValue, 13_000e6, \">13,000 USDT of yield on a 50,000 USDT deposit is unclaimable\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n        assertEq(received, 49_850e6, \"she still just gets principal minus the exit fee\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3831,"cache_read_input_tokens":53152,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3831},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"3649ab79-7a61-451b-8809-2a1515d1674d","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:21:07.347Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEduszejezjZtMJ88jK"}

vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        pool.accrue(500); // +5% interest on everything supplied\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n burned the vault still holds real aUSDT, and every\n    ///         accounting variable that could point at it reads zero.\n    function test_StrandedValueIsUnreachableAfterFullExit() public {\n aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The loss is not a rounding dust artefact — it is the entire yield, and it\n    ///         compounds with time and TVL.\n    function test_StrandedValueScalesWithTimeAndTvl() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(50_000e6);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            pool.accrue(500); // five periods of 5%\n        }\n\n        uint256 realValue = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 creditedValue = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        console2.log(\"real aUSDT held    :\", realValue);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice  :\", creditedValue);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost by alice:\", realValue - creditedValue);\n\n        assertGt(realValue - creditedValue, 13_000e6, \">13,000 USDT of yield on a 50,000 USDT deposit is unclaimable\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n        assertEq(received, 49_850e6, \"she still just gets principal minus the exit fee\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEiSdJ77JaZgwe9hGVB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KJRxF8u7yG8VuWQPDYncef","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/FeeAccounting.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice README.md and the contract NatSpec both state: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and\n///         accrue to the remaining shareholders\". This suite checks that claim. It uses the\n///         project's own non-rebasing MockAavePool, so every number below is pure fee accounting\n///         with no interest mixed in.\ncontract FeeAccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-2  the withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeDoesNotAccrueToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        vm.recordLogs();\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 surplus = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable before alice's exit:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable after  alice's exit:\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"alice's withdrawal fee            :\", surplus);\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6.\n        assertLe(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"bob gained NOTHING from alice's 3 USDT exit fee\");\n        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"the fee is sitting in Aave, owned by no share\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Root cause: `withdraw` debits `totalAssetsStored` by the GROSS amount while only\n    ///         pulling the NET amount out of Aave. The difference silently leaves the accounting\n    ///         system instead of raising the share price.\n    function test_TotalAssetsStoredDivergesFromRealBackingOnEveryWithdrawal() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"in sync before any withdrawal\");\n\n        uint256 slice = aliceShares / 10;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n            vm.prank(alice);\n            vault.withdraw(slice);\n            console2.log(\"after withdrawal\", i + 1);\n            console2.log(\"  aUSDT held        :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n            console2.log(\"  totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        }\n\n        uint256 drift = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n        console2.log(\"unowned drift after 10 withdrawals:\", drift);\n        assertGt(drift, 29e6, \"~0.3% of every exit permanently detaches from the share supply\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        L-1  the deposit fee is refunded to the first depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `deposit` mints shares on the NET amount but credits `totalAssetsStored` with the\n    ///         GROSS amount. For the first depositor there is nobody else to dilute, so the fee\n    ///         lands straight back in their own share price: a 1000 USDT deposit is instantly\n    ///         worth 1000 USDT again. The fee is only real once someone else is in the pool.\n    function test_FirstDepositorPaysNoDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(500); // 5%\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited      :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"alice redeemable     :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"5% fee charged, 5% fee refunded\");\n\n        // Second depositor pays it in full, and it goes to alice.\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob deposited        :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable       :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n        console2.log(\"alice's gain from bob:\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore);\n        assertLt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), aliceBefore);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":648,"cache_read_input_tokens":61894,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":648},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"c72b35e3-0ba5-484e-8f46-ff30f9c89452","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:21:44.175Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEiRMtZU3sxYwh3Znke"}

This suite checks that claim. It uses the\n///         project's own non-rebasing MockAavePool, so every number below is pure fee accounting\n///         with no interest mixed in.\ncontract FeeAccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-2  the withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeDoesNotAccrueToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        vm.recordLogs();\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 surplus = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable before alice's exit:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable after  alice's exit:\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"alice's withdrawal fee            :\", surplus);\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6.\n        assertLe(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"bob gained NOTHING from alice's 3 USDT exit fee\");\n        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"the fee is sitting in Aave, owned by no share\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Root cause: `withdraw` debits `totalAssetsStored` by the GROSS amount while only\n    ///         pulling the NET amount out of Aave. The difference silently leaves the accounting\n    ///         system instead of raising the share price.\n    function test_TotalAssetsStoredDivergesFromRealBackingOnEveryWithdrawal() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"in sync before any withdrawal\");\n\n        uint256 slice = aliceShares / 10;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n            vm.prank(alice);\n            vault.withdraw(slice);\n            console2.log(\"after withdrawal\", i + 1);\n            console2.log(\"  aUSDT held        :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n            console2.log(\"  totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        }\n\n        uint256 drift = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n        console2.log(\"unowned drift after 10 withdrawals:\", drift);\n        assertGt(drift, 29e6, \"~0.3% of every exit permanently detaches from the share supply\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        L-1  the deposit fee is refunded to the first depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `deposit` mints shares on the NET amount but credits `totalAssetsStored` with the\n    ///         GROSS amount. For the first depositor there is nobody else to dilute, so the fee\n    ///         lands straight back in their own share price: a 1000 USDT deposit is instantly\n    ///         worth 1000 USDT again. The fee is only real once someone else is in the pool.\n    function test_FirstDepositorPaysNoDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(500); // 5%\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited      :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"alice redeemable     :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"5% fee charged, 5% fee refunded\");\n\n        // Second depositor pays it in full, and it goes to alice.\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob deposited        :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable       :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n        console2.log(\"alice's gain from bob:\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore);\n        assertLt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), aliceBefore);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

Observed gain is 1 base unit of rounding dust.\n        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"alice's ~3 USDT exit fee is sitting in Aave\");\n        assertLt(bobAfter - bobBefore, 100, \"bob receives none of it\");"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1151,"cache_read_input_tokens":65849,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1151},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"a0c1c9d0-575f-4a75-b054-ef6759178fa6","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:21:59.410Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEmAfBsMtbsjdvcs6y8"}
