(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"0153b536-051b-4cac-9104-42703dc1855b","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:21:59.421Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/FeeAccounting.t.sol","oldString":"        console2.log(\"alice's withdrawal fee            :\", surplus);\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6.\n        assertLe(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"bob gained NOTHING from alice's 3 USDT exit fee\");\n        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"the fee is sitting in Aave, owned by no share\");","newString":"        console2.log(\"bob's gain                        :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"alice's withdrawal fee            :\", surplus);\n\n        // Documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6 (the whole fee, since bob\n        // holds ~100% of the remaining shares). Observed gain is 1 base unit of rounding dust.\n        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"alice's ~3 USDT exit fee is sitting in Aave\");\n        assertLt(bobAfter - bobBefore, 100, \"bob receives none of it\");","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice README.md and the contract NatSpec both state: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and\n///         accrue to the remaining shareholders\". This suite checks that claim. It uses the\n///         project's own non-rebasing MockAavePool, so every number below is pure fee accounting\n///         with no interest mixed in.\ncontract FeeAccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-2  the withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeDoesNotAccrueToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        vm.recordLogs();\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 surplus = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable before alice's exit:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable after  alice's exit:\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"alice's withdrawal fee            :\", surplus);\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6.\n        assertLe(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"bob gained NOTHING from alice's 3 USDT exit fee\");\n        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"the fee is sitting in Aave, owned by no share\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Root cause: `withdraw` debits `totalAssetsStored` by the GROSS amount while only\n    ///         pulling the NET amount out of Aave. The difference silently leaves the accounting\n    ///         system instead of raising the share price.\n    function test_TotalAssetsStoredDivergesFromRealBackingOnEveryWithdrawal() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"in sync before any withdrawal\");\n\n        uint256 slice = aliceShares / 10;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n            vm.prank(alice);\n            vault.withdraw(slice);\n            console2.log(\"after withdrawal\", i + 1);\n            console2.log(\"  aUSDT held        :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n            console2.log(\"  totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        }\n\n        uint256 drift = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n        console2.log(\"unowned drift after 10 withdrawals:\", drift);\n        assertGt(drift, 29e6, \"~0.3% of every exit permanently detaches from the share supply\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        L-1  the deposit fee is refunded to the first depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `deposit` mints shares on the NET amount but credits `totalAssetsStored` with the\n    ///         GROSS amount. For the first depositor there is nobody else to dilute, so the fee\n    ///         lands straight back in their own share price: a 1000 USDT deposit is instantly\n    ///         worth 1000 USDT again. The fee is only real once someone else is in the pool.\n    function test_FirstDepositorPaysNoDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(500); // 5%\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited      :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"alice redeemable     :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"5% fee charged, 5% fee refunded\");\n\n        // Second depositor pays it in full, and it goes to alice.\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob deposited        :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob redeemable       :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n        console2.log(\"alice's gain from bob:\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore);\n        assertLt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), aliceBefore);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":58,"oldLines":11,"newStart":58,"newLines":13,"lines":[" ","         console2.log(\"bob redeemable before alice's exit:\", bobBefore);","         console2.log(\"bob redeemable after  alice's exit:\", bobAfter);","+        console2.log(\"bob's gain                        :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);","         console2.log(\"alice's withdrawal fee            :\", surplus);"," ","-        // The documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6.","-        assertLe(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"bob gained NOTHING from alice's 3 USDT exit fee\");","-        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"the fee is sitting in Aave, owned by no share\");","+        // Documented behaviour would be bobAfter == bobBefore + ~3e6 (the whole fee, since bob","+        // holds ~100% of the remaining shares). Observed gain is 1 base unit of rounding dust.","+        assertApproxEqAbs(surplus, 3e6, 1e4, \"alice's ~3 USDT exit fee is sitting in Aave\");","+        assertLt(bobAfter - bobBefore, 100, \"bob receives none of it\");","     }"," ","     /// @notice Root cause: `withdraw` debits `totalAssetsStored` by the GROSS amount while only"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEmxy19YHTW1WJEHEvo","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012r7pmXxFNfDZduSNfjUk14","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/OwnerPowers.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice What the owner key can do to depositors. The existing suite checks that\n///         `setDepositFee` and `pause` are onlyOwner; it never checks what happens when the\n///         owner actually uses them.\ncontract OwnerPowersTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-3  setDepositFee is unbounded: the owner can take a deposit\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `setDepositFee` has no upper bound, no timelock, and `deposit` has no\n    ///         minimum-shares-out argument. The owner (who holds shares as `alice` here) can\n    ///         sit in the mempool, raise the fee to 99.99% in front of bob's deposit, and take\n    ///         essentially all of it. Bob has no way to express \"revert if I get less than X\".\n    function test_OwnerCanFrontRunADepositAndTakeIt() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT); // alice == the owner's own position\n\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        // ---- same block, owner's tx orders first ----\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        // ---------------------------------------------\n\n        uint256 bobValue = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 aliceGain = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"bob paid in            :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob's position is worth:\", bobValue);\n        console2.log(\"owner's position gained:\", aliceGain);\n\n        assertLt(bobValue, 1e6, \"bob's 1000 USDT is worth under 1 USDT\");\n        assertGt(aliceGain, 990e6, \"the owner took over 990 USDT of it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A 100% fee bricks deposits outright.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetA100PercentFeeAndBrickDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.NoSharesMinted.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Above 100% the fee underflows `amount - fee` and deposits revert with a panic.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetAFeeAbove100PercentAndDepositsPanic() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 10_001, \"accepted without complaint\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(stdError.arithmeticError);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-4  pause() freezes withdrawals, and it can be made permanent\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `withdraw` is `whenNotPaused`. There is no emergency-exit path, so a paused\n    ///         vault is a vault nobody can leave.\n    function test_PauseFreezesDepositorFunds() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"her money is still in there\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Worst case: `Ownable.renounceOwnership` is inherited and not disabled. Pause,\n    ///         then renounce, and the funds are frozen forever with no key left that can undo it.\n    function test_PauseThenRenounceOwnershipLocksFundsForever() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0), \"no owner left\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        // Nobody can unpause: the only caller that could is address(0).\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, owner));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console2.log(\"permanently locked aUSDT:\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        M-1  constructor accepts anything\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice No zero-address checks, no upper bound on the initial fee, and no check that\n    ///         `_aUsdt` is the aToken the pool will actually mint. A fat-fingered deploy is\n    ///         immutable and unfixable.\n    function test_ConstructorAcceptsGarbage() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault bad = new UsdtYieldVault(address(0), address(0), address(0), type(uint256).max, owner);\n        assertEq(address(bad.usdt()), address(0));\n        assertEq(address(bad.aavePool()), address(0));\n        assertEq(bad.depositFeeBps(), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // And `aUsdt` is decorative: the vault never reads it, so a wrong address is silent.\n        UsdtYieldVault wrongAToken =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"deposit succeeded with a bogus aUsdt address; shares:\", wrongAToken.totalShares());\n        assertGt(wrongAToken.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":793,"cache_read_input_tokens":67000,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":793},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"7dfa1195-2124-4a29-9ff6-8fe084c7fe3c","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:22:31.417Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEmwgNKiXWRk1NpxqCn"}

The existing suite checks that\n///         `setDepositFee` and `pause` are onlyOwner; it never checks what happens when the\n///         owner actually uses them.\ncontract OwnerPowersTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-3  setDepositFee is unbounded: the owner can take a deposit\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `setDepositFee` has no upper bound, no timelock, and `deposit` has no\n    ///         minimum-shares-out argument. The owner (who holds shares as `alice` here) can\n    ///         sit in the mempool, raise the fee to 99.99% in front of bob's deposit, and take\n    ///         essentially all of it. Bob has no way to express \"revert if I get less than X\".\n    function test_OwnerCanFrontRunADepositAndTakeIt() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT); // alice == the owner's own position\n\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        // ---- same block, owner's tx orders first ----\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        // ---------------------------------------------\n\n        uint256 bobValue = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 aliceGain = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"bob paid in            :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob's position is worth:\", bobValue);\n        console2.log(\"owner's position gained:\", aliceGain);\n\n        assertLt(bobValue, 1e6, \"bob's 1000 USDT is worth under 1 USDT\");\n        assertGt(aliceGain, 990e6, \"the owner took over 990 USDT of it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A 100% fee bricks deposits outright.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetA100PercentFeeAndBrickDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.NoSharesMinted.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Above 100% the fee underflows `amount - fee` and deposits revert with a panic.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetAFeeAbove100PercentAndDepositsPanic() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 10_001, \"accepted without complaint\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(stdError.arithmeticError);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-4  pause() freezes withdrawals, and it can be made permanent\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `withdraw` is `whenNotPaused`. There is no emergency-exit path, so a paused\n    ///         vault is a vault nobody can leave.\n    function test_PauseFreezesDepositorFunds() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"her money is still in there\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Worst case: `Ownable.renounceOwnership` is inherited and not disabled. Pause,\n    ///         then renounce, and the funds are frozen forever with no key left that can undo it.\n    function test_PauseThenRenounceOwnershipLocksFundsForever() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0), \"no owner left\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        // Nobody can unpause: the only caller that could is address(0).\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, owner));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console2.log(\"permanently locked aUSDT:\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        M-1  constructor accepts anything\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice No zero-address checks, no upper bound on the initial fee, and no check that\n    ///         `_aUsdt` is the aToken the pool will actually mint. A fat-fingered deploy is\n    ///         immutable and unfixable.\n    function test_ConstructorAcceptsGarbage() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault bad = new UsdtYieldVault(address(0), address(0), address(0), type(uint256).max, owner);\n        assertEq(address(bad.usdt()), address(0));\n        assertEq(address(bad.aavePool()), address(0));\n        assertEq(bad.depositFeeBps(), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // And `aUsdt` is decorative: the vault never reads it, so a wrong address is silent.\n        UsdtYieldVault wrongAToken =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"deposit succeeded with a bogus aUsdt address; shares:\", wrongAToken.totalShares());\n        assertGt(wrongAToken.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

mainnet USDT returns nothing.\n///         That single difference is why 39 tests pass and the contract cannot take a deposit.\ncontract UsdtCompatibilityTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    UsdtLikeToken internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        C-1  deposit() cannot work against a USDT-shaped token\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_DepositRevertsAgainstUsdtLikeToken() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = address(vault).call(abi.encodeCall(UsdtYieldVault.deposit, (DEPOSIT_AMOUNT)));\n\n        console2.log(\"deposit() succeeded:\", ok);\n        assertFalse(ok, \"deposit reverts: usdt.approve() returns no bool for IERC20 to decode\");\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), 100_000e6, \"no funds moved\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Isolates the exact line. `safeTransferFrom` (line 93) tolerates the missing return\n    ///         value; the bare `usdt.approve` (line 94) does not.\n    function test_SafeErc20HandlesItButTheBareApproveDoesNot() public {\n        // SafeERC20-style call: fine.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool rawOk, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(usdt).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(pool), 1));\n        assertTrue(rawOk);\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"no return data\");\n\n        // What the vault does: decode it as IERC20 -> revert.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(address(usdt)).approve(address(pool), 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        M-2  fee-on-transfer breaks the accounting outright\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice USDT's `basisPointsRate` is 0 today but Tether can set it. `deposit` assumes the\n    ///         vault receives the full `amount` it asked for: it supplies `amount` to Aave and\n    ///         credits `totalAssetsStored += amount`. With any transfer fee the vault holds less\n    ///         than `amount` and the Aave supply reverts on every deposit.\n    ///\n    ///         Uses a bool-returning token so the failure is attributable to the fee, not to C-1.\n    function test_FeeOnTransferBreaksEveryDeposit() public {\n        FeeTakingUsdt feeUsdt = new FeeTakingUsdt();\n        MockAavePool feePool = new MockAavePool(address(feeUsdt));\n        MockAToken feeAToken = feePool.aToken();\n        UsdtYieldVault feeVault =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(feeUsdt), address(feeAToken), address(feePool), 10, owner);\n\n        feeUsdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        feeUsdt.approve(address(feeVault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // Fee off: works.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        feeVault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(feeVault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        // Tether flips the fee on (10 bps, capped at the real contract's limits).\n        feeUsdt.setFee(10);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = address(feeVault).call(abi.encodeCall(UsdtYieldVault.deposit, (DEPOSIT_AMOUNT)));\n        console2.log(\"deposit() with a 10bps transfer fee succeeded:\", ok);\n        assertFalse(ok, \"vault received 999 USDT but tries to supply 1000 to Aave\");\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Standard-ABI ERC20 that skims a transfer fee, isolating the fee-on-transfer failure.\ncontract FeeTakingUsdt {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    uint256 public feeBps;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function setFee(uint256 bps) external {\n        feeBps = bps;\n    }\n\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            require(allowed >= value, \"allowance\");\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"balance\");\n        uint256 fee = (value * feeBps) / 10_000;\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += value - fee;\n        balanceOf[address(this)] += fee;\n        emit Transfer(from, to, value - fee);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3172,"cache_read_input_tokens":67793,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3172},"output_tokens":47,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"6c45f6bd-25e4-44cd-8317-b0350b0a5723","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:23:00.317Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEpKZ4fSA5iEMAEeS1i"}

function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function setFee(uint256 bps) external {\n        feeBps = bps;\n    }\n\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            require(allowed >= value, \"allowance\");\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"balance\");\n        uint256 fee = (value * feeBps) / 10_000;\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += value - fee;\n        balanceOf[address(this)] += fee;\n        emit Transfer(from, to, value - fee);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"273f6432-34cf-450a-a30d-46241cd42042","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:23:20.514Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/OwnerPowers.t.sol","oldString":"import {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";","newString":"import {Test, console2, stdError} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice What the owner key can do to depositors. The existing suite checks that\n///         `setDepositFee` and `pause` are onlyOwner; it never checks what happens when the\n///         owner actually uses them.\ncontract OwnerPowersTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-3  setDepositFee is unbounded: the owner can take a deposit\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `setDepositFee` has no upper bound, no timelock, and `deposit` has no\n    ///         minimum-shares-out argument. The owner (who holds shares as `alice` here) can\n    ///         sit in the mempool, raise the fee to 99.99% in front of bob's deposit, and take\n    ///         essentially all of it. Bob has no way to express \"revert if I get less than X\".\n    function test_OwnerCanFrontRunADepositAndTakeIt() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT); // alice == the owner's own position\n\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        // ---- same block, owner's tx orders first ----\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        // ---------------------------------------------\n\n        uint256 bobValue = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 aliceGain = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"bob paid in            :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob's position is worth:\", bobValue);\n        console2.log(\"owner's position gained:\", aliceGain);\n\n        assertLt(bobValue, 1e6, \"bob's 1000 USDT is worth under 1 USDT\");\n        assertGt(aliceGain, 990e6, \"the owner took over 990 USDT of it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A 100% fee bricks deposits outright.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetA100PercentFeeAndBrickDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.NoSharesMinted.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Above 100% the fee underflows `amount - fee` and deposits revert with a panic.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetAFeeAbove100PercentAndDepositsPanic() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 10_001, \"accepted without complaint\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(stdError.arithmeticError);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-4  pause() freezes withdrawals, and it can be made permanent\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `withdraw` is `whenNotPaused`. There is no emergency-exit path, so a paused\n    ///         vault is a vault nobody can leave.\n    function test_PauseFreezesDepositorFunds() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"her money is still in there\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Worst case: `Ownable.renounceOwnership` is inherited and not disabled. Pause,\n    ///         then renounce, and the funds are frozen forever with no key left that can undo it.\n    function test_PauseThenRenounceOwnershipLocksFundsForever() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0), \"no owner left\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        // Nobody can unpause: the only caller that could is address(0).\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, owner));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console2.log(\"permanently locked aUSDT:\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        M-1  constructor accepts anything\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice No zero-address checks, no upper bound on the initial fee, and no check that\n    ///         `_aUsdt` is the aToken the pool will actually mint. A fat-fingered deploy is\n    ///         immutable and unfixable.\n    function test_ConstructorAcceptsGarbage() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault bad = new UsdtYieldVault(address(0), address(0), address(0), type(uint256).max, owner);\n        assertEq(address(bad.usdt()), address(0));\n        assertEq(address(bad.aavePool()), address(0));\n        assertEq(bad.depositFeeBps(), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // And `aUsdt` is decorative: the vault never reads it, so a wrong address is silent.\n        UsdtYieldVault wrongAToken =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"deposit succeeded with a bogus aUsdt address; shares:\", wrongAToken.totalShares());\n        assertGt(wrongAToken.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":7,"newStart":1,"newLines":7,"lines":[" // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT"," pragma solidity 0.8.28;"," ","-import {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";","+import {Test, console2, stdError} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";"," import {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";"," import {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"a2e10988-6424-483c-86ad-140dcf9b86f3","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:23:33.931Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/OwnerPowers.t.sol","oldString":"            new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);","newString":"            new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(wrongAToken), type(uint256).max);\n        wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.stopPrank();","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2, stdError} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice What the owner key can do to depositors. The existing suite checks that\n///         `setDepositFee` and `pause` are onlyOwner; it never checks what happens when the\n///         owner actually uses them.\ncontract OwnerPowersTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-3  setDepositFee is unbounded: the owner can take a deposit\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `setDepositFee` has no upper bound, no timelock, and `deposit` has no\n    ///         minimum-shares-out argument. The owner (who holds shares as `alice` here) can\n    ///         sit in the mempool, raise the fee to 99.99% in front of bob's deposit, and take\n    ///         essentially all of it. Bob has no way to express \"revert if I get less than X\".\n    function test_OwnerCanFrontRunADepositAndTakeIt() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT); // alice == the owner's own position\n\n        uint256 aliceBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        // ---- same block, owner's tx orders first ----\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        // ---------------------------------------------\n\n        uint256 bobValue = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 aliceGain = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) - aliceBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"bob paid in            :\", DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"bob's position is worth:\", bobValue);\n        console2.log(\"owner's position gained:\", aliceGain);\n\n        assertLt(bobValue, 1e6, \"bob's 1000 USDT is worth under 1 USDT\");\n        assertGt(aliceGain, 990e6, \"the owner took over 990 USDT of it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A 100% fee bricks deposits outright.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetA100PercentFeeAndBrickDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.NoSharesMinted.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Above 100% the fee underflows `amount - fee` and deposits revert with a panic.\n    function test_OwnerCanSetAFeeAbove100PercentAndDepositsPanic() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 10_001, \"accepted without complaint\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(stdError.arithmeticError);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        H-4  pause() freezes withdrawals, and it can be made permanent\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `withdraw` is `whenNotPaused`. There is no emergency-exit path, so a paused\n    ///         vault is a vault nobody can leave.\n    function test_PauseFreezesDepositorFunds() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, \"her money is still in there\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Worst case: `Ownable.renounceOwnership` is inherited and not disabled. Pause,\n    ///         then renounce, and the funds are frozen forever with no key left that can undo it.\n    function test_PauseThenRenounceOwnershipLocksFundsForever() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0), \"no owner left\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        // Nobody can unpause: the only caller that could is address(0).\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, owner));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console2.log(\"permanently locked aUSDT:\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        M-1  constructor accepts anything\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice No zero-address checks, no upper bound on the initial fee, and no check that\n    ///         `_aUsdt` is the aToken the pool will actually mint. A fat-fingered deploy is\n    ///         immutable and unfixable.\n    function test_ConstructorAcceptsGarbage() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault bad = new UsdtYieldVault(address(0), address(0), address(0), type(uint256).max, owner);\n        assertEq(address(bad.usdt()), address(0));\n        assertEq(address(bad.aavePool()), address(0));\n        assertEq(bad.depositFeeBps(), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // And `aUsdt` is decorative: the vault never reads it, so a wrong address is silent.\n        UsdtYieldVault wrongAToken =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        console2.log(\"deposit succeeded with a bogus aUsdt address; shares:\", wrongAToken.totalShares());\n        assertGt(wrongAToken.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":158,"oldLines":8,"newStart":158,"newLines":10,"lines":["         // And `aUsdt` is decorative: the vault never reads it, so a wrong address is silent.","         UsdtYieldVault wrongAToken =","             new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), makeAddr(\"not-the-atoken\"), address(pool), 10, owner);","-        vm.prank(alice);","+        vm.startPrank(alice);","+        usdt.approve(address(wrongAToken), type(uint256).max);","         wrongAToken.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);","+        vm.stopPrank();","         console2.log(\"deposit succeeded with a bogus aUsdt address; shares:\", wrongAToken.totalShares());","         assertGt(wrongAToken.totalShares(), 0);","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEuaPBKsZoLjqAiXeQR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01K3DebE52HmuSW7AvLvzQR1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/VaultInvariants.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/Harness.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Drives the vault with random sequences of deposits, withdrawals, interest accrual\n///         and fee changes.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool public pool;\n\n    address[3] public actors;\n\n    uint256 public ghostDeposited;\n    uint256 public ghostWithdrawn;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, RebasingAavePool _pool, address[3] memory _actors) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        pool = _pool;\n        actors = _actors;\n    }\n\n    function _actor(uint256 seed) internal view returns (address) {\n        return actors[seed % actors.length];\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 amount) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        if (usdt.balanceOf(actor) < amount) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.deposit(amount) {\n            ghostDeposited += amount;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 sharesPct) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        uint256 held = vault.shareBalance(actor);\n        if (held == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 shares = (held * bound(sharesPct, 1, 100)) / 100;\n        if (shares == 0) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n            ghostWithdrawn += netAssets;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    function accrueInterest(uint256 bps) external {\n        pool.accrue(bound(bps, 0, 200));\n    }\n\n    function changeFee(uint256 bps) external {\n        vm.prank(vault.owner());\n        vault.setDepositFee(bound(bps, 0, 500));\n    }\n\n    function totalClaimableByShareholders() external view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.balanceOfUnderlying(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.runs = 128\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.depth = 100\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.fail-on-revert = false\ncontract VaultInvariantsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address[3] internal actors = [makeAddr(\"alice\"), makeAddr(\"bob\"), makeAddr(\"carol\")];\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, pool, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        THE PROPERTY THAT HOLDS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault is never short: it always holds at least as much aUSDT as its\n    ///         internal counter claims. Depositors cannot be rugged by a bank run.\n    function invariant_VaultIsNeverInsolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            \"vault holds less than totalAssetsStored\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                      THE PROPERTIES THAT DO NOT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every USDT the vault holds should be claimable by some shareholder. It is not:\n    ///         yield and withdrawal fees detach from the share supply and are owned by nobody.\n    function invariant_EveryAssetHeldIsClaimableBySomeShareholder() public view {\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 claimable = handler.totalClaimableByShareholders();\n        assertApproxEqAbs(claimable, held, 10, \"unclaimable value stranded in the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A vault that supplies into Aave should hand the interest to its depositors, so\n    ///         `totalAssets()` should track the aUSDT position. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/Harness.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Drives the vault with random sequences of deposits, withdrawals, interest accrual\n///         and fee changes.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool public pool;\n\n    address[3] public actors;\n\n    uint256 public ghostDeposited;\n    uint256 public ghostWithdrawn;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, RebasingAavePool _pool, address[3] memory _actors) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        pool = _pool;\n        actors = _actors;\n    }\n\n    function _actor(uint256 seed) internal view returns (address) {\n        return actors[seed % actors.length];\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 amount) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        if (usdt.balanceOf(actor) < amount) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.deposit(amount) {\n            ghostDeposited += amount;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 sharesPct) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        uint256 held = vault.shareBalance(actor);\n        if (held == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 shares = (held * bound(sharesPct, 1, 100)) / 100;\n        if (shares == 0) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n            ghostWithdrawn += netAssets;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    function accrueInterest(uint256 bps) external {\n        pool.accrue(bound(bps, 0, 200));\n    }\n\n    function changeFee(uint256 bps) external {\n        vm.prank(vault.owner());\n        vault.setDepositFee(bound(bps, 0, 500));\n    }\n\n    function totalClaimableByShareholders() external view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.balanceOfUnderlying(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.runs = 128\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.depth = 100\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.fail-on-revert = false\ncontract VaultInvariantsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address[3] internal actors = [makeAddr(\"alice\"), makeAddr(\"bob\"), makeAddr(\"carol\")];\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, pool, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        THE PROPERTY THAT HOLDS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault is never short: it always holds at least as much aUSDT as its\n    ///         internal counter claims. Depositors cannot be rugged by a bank run.\n    function invariant_VaultIsNeverInsolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            \"vault holds less than totalAssetsStored\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                      THE PROPERTIES THAT DO NOT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every USDT the vault holds should be claimable by some shareholder. It is not:\n    ///         yield and withdrawal fees detach from the share supply and are owned by nobody.\n    function invariant_EveryAssetHeldIsClaimableBySomeShareholder() public view {\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 claimable = handler.totalClaimableByShareholders();\n        assertApproxEqAbs(claimable, held, 10, \"unclaimable value stranded in the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A vault that supplies into Aave should hand the interest to its depositors, so\n    ///         `totalAssets()` should track the aUSDT position. It is a static counter instead.\n    function invariant_TotalAssetsTracksTheAavePosition() public view {\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.totalAssets(),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            10,\n            \"totalAssets() ignores the real Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    function invariant_CallSummary() public view {\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held        :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"claimable by users:\", handler.totalClaimableByShareholders());\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEy1uv5dZ4QFHX8vkgz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Xd2rm2xt8Pedkuf1BkyxfA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081452Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/test/VaultInvariants.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/Harness.sol\";\n\ninterface IAToken {\n    function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);\n}\n\ninterface IAccruingPool {\n    function accrue(uint256 bps) external;\n}\n\n/// @notice Drives the vault with random sequences of deposits, withdrawals, interest accrual and\n///         fee changes. `accrueInterest` is a no-op when the pool underneath does not pay interest.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    address public pool;\n    bool public poolAccrues;\n\n    address[3] public actors;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, address _pool, bool _poolAccrues, address[3] memory _actors) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        pool = _pool;\n        poolAccrues = _poolAccrues;\n        actors = _actors;\n    }\n\n    function _actor(uint256 seed) internal view returns (address) {\n        return actors[seed % actors.length];\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 amount) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        if (usdt.balanceOf(actor) < amount) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.deposit(amount) {} catch {}\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 sharesPct) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        uint256 held = vault.shareBalance(actor);\n        if (held == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 shares = (held * bound(sharesPct, 1, 100)) / 100;\n        if (shares == 0) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) {} catch {}\n    }\n\n    function accrueInterest(uint256 bps) external {\n        if (!poolAccrues) return;\n        IAccruingPool(pool).accrue(bound(bps, 0, 200));\n    }\n\n    function changeFee(uint256 bps) external {\n        vm.prank(vault.owner());\n        vault.setDepositFee(bound(bps, 0, 500));\n    }\n\n    function totalClaimableByShareholders() external view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.balanceOfUnderlying(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        THE PROPERTY THAT HOLDS — checked on the project's own\n        1:1 MockAavePool so there is no aToken index rounding\n        to muddy the result.\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.runs = 128\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.depth = 100\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.fail-on-revert = false\ncontract VaultSolvencyInvariantTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address[3] internal actors = [makeAddr(\"alice\"), makeAddr(\"bob\"), makeAddr(\"carol\")];\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, address(pool), false, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The vault is never short: it always holds at least as much aUSDT as its internal\n    ///         counter claims. No bank run leaves the last depositor unable to exit. This one\n    ///         holds — the failures below are all value going the *other* way.\n    function invariant_VaultIsNeverInsolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), vault.totalAssetsStored(), \"vault holds less than totalAssetsStored\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        THE PROPERTIES THAT DO NOT — same handler, on a pool\n        that pays interest the way Aave V3 does.\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.runs = 128\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.depth = 100\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.fail-on-revert = false\ncontract VaultValueLeakInvariantTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address[3] internal actors = [makeAddr(\"alice\"), makeAddr(\"bob\"), makeAddr(\"carol\")];\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, address(pool), true, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Every USDT the vault holds should be claimable by some shareholder. It is not:\n    ///         withdrawal fees and Aave interest detach from the share supply and belong to\n    ///         nobody. Reachable with no interest at all — one deposit and one withdrawal.\n    function invariant_EveryAssetHeldIsClaimableBySomeShareholder() public view {\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 claimable = handler.totalClaimableByShareholders();\n        assertApproxEqAbs(claimable, held, 10, \"unclaimable value stranded in the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A vault that supplies into Aave should pass the interest to its depositors, so\n    ///         `totalAssets()` should track the aUSDT position. It is a static counter instead.\n    function invariant_TotalAssetsTracksTheAavePosition() public view {\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 10, \"totalAssets() ignores the real Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2668,"cache_read_input_tokens":80879,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2668},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"054adcf3-b3f9-48ed-a62a-6afd61d8acec","uuid":"7cd101fb-e8d1-4943-be1e-f38e8995b91b","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:25:10.603Z","request_id":"req_011CdSExyQMhaUFPBCCbXkr7"}

handler.totalClaimableByShareholders());","-    }"," }"]}],"originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/Harness.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Drives the vault with random sequences of deposits, withdrawals, interest accrual\n///         and fee changes.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool public pool;\n\n    address[3] public actors;\n\n    uint256 public ghostDeposited;\n    uint256 public ghostWithdrawn;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, RebasingAavePool _pool, address[3] memory _actors) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        pool = _pool;\n        actors = _actors;\n    }\n\n    function _actor(uint256 seed) internal view returns (address) {\n        return actors[seed % actors.length];\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 amount) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        if (usdt.balanceOf(actor) < amount) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.deposit(amount) {\n            ghostDeposited += amount;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 sharesPct) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        uint256 held = vault.shareBalance(actor);\n        if (held == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 shares = (held * bound(sharesPct, 1, 100)) / 100;\n        if (shares == 0) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n            ghostWithdrawn += netAssets;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    function accrueInterest(uint256 bps) external {\n        pool.accrue(bound(bps, 0, 200));\n    }\n\n    function changeFee(uint256 bps) external {\n        vm.prank(vault.owner());\n        vault.setDepositFee(bound(bps, 0, 500));\n    }\n\n    function totalClaimableByShareholders() external view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.balanceOfUnderlying(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.runs = 128\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.depth = 100\n/// forge-config: default.invariant.fail-on-revert = false\ncontract VaultInvariantsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address[3] internal actors = [makeAddr(\"alice\"), makeAddr(\"bob\"), makeAddr(\"carol\")];\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, pool, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        THE PROPERTY THAT HOLDS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault is never short: it always holds at least as much aUSDT as its\n    ///         internal counter claims. Depositors cannot be rugged by a bank run.\n    function invariant_VaultIsNeverInsolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            \"vault holds less than totalAssetsStored\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                      THE PROPERTIES THAT DO NOT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every USDT the vault holds should be claimable by some shareholder. It is not:\n    ///         yield and withdrawal fees detach from the share supply and are owned by nobody.\n    function invariant_EveryAssetHeldIsClaimableBySomeShareholder() public view {\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 claimable = handler.totalClaimableByShareholders();\n        assertApproxEqAbs(claimable, held, 10, \"unclaimable value stranded in the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A vault that supplies into Aave should hand the interest to its depositors, so\n    ///         `totalAssets()` should track the aUSDT position. It is a static counter instead.\n    function invariant_TotalAssetsTracksTheAavePosition() public view {\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.totalAssets(),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            10,\n            \"totalAssets() ignores the real Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    function invariant_CallSummary() public view {\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held        :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"claimable by users:\", handler.totalClaimableByShareholders());\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false}}
